title: The product search box returns other people's orders
brief: QA typed a quote into the search box and the page filled with rows from a table search should never touch. This is the gentlest version of the problem: one input, one query, no login involved.

attackSuite.payload: ' UNION SELECT id, email, 0 FROM users --
attackSuite.label: Reads a table it should not

hints: The quote the tester typed ended the string early. Everything after it was read as instructions.
Stripping the quote would break the O'Neill listing. What lets the database keep the value and the query separate?
Pass the LIKE pattern as a bound parameter: db.query(sql, [`%${term}%`]).
